title: Roos comparison naturality in the additive functor
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories with countable products, F and G additive functors A to B, alpha:F to G a natural transformation, and C a strict inverse tower of cochain complexes. The termwise alpha on Roos(C), followed by scalarRoosMap G C, equals scalarRoosMap F C followed by Roos of the termwise alpha on C [def-sf-additive-roos-map, def-sf-strict-roos-functor].

proof.text: For the unshifted product coordinate compose with each projection. The defining diagonal scalar Roos formulas and strict tower map formulas reduce equality to naturality of alpha.

The shifted product coordinate in degree i-1 gives the same naturality square. Product projections detect both equalities and the two mapping-cocone coordinates sum to the identity, proving equality in each degree.

theorem scalarRoos_functor_naturality (F G : 𝒜 ⥤ ℬ) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (α : F ⟶ G) (C : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex 𝒜 ℤ) :
    (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex α (.up ℤ)).app (integralOperationsRoos C) ≫
        scalarRoosMap G C =
      scalarRoosMap F C ≫ integralOperationsRoosMap
        (Functor.whiskerLeft C (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex α (.up ℤ)))
